question: How large is the real program-compatibility envelope of the DBI backend (real Detcore<DbiGuest>) after PR #713 wired DetConfig, and where are the remaining backend-parity gaps versus ptrace?
dbi_native_client: detcore-dbi cdylib built by detcore_dbi::prepare_native_client() via cmake from reverie_dbi::native_client_source_dir()

host.note: shared devserver under heavy concurrent load (30+ other hermit processes during measurement); isolated timeouts required to avoid contention-induced false TIMEOUTs

commands.functional_and_parity: bash run_matrix.sh   (native vs ptrace vs dbi run: stdout+exit)
commands.l2_determinism: bash l2_sweep.sh   (hermit run --backend dbi --strict --verify: bitwise-identical repeat)
commands.combined: bash combined_matrix.sh   (produces results.csv: native/ptrace/dbi-run/dbi-L2 per program)
commands.clock_probe: hermit run --backend dbi -- ./clockprobe   (vDSO vs forced raw clock_gettime syscall)

env_setup: source hermit/.env.dbi is NOT required (DynamoRIO + client are bundled/auto-built); a stale reflinked target/ CMakeCache must be cleared: rm -rf target/release/**/detcore-dbi-native-* before first DBI run in a fresh worktree
